Access/Refresh Token Auth
nodes.rationale: Short-lived access (15m) + rotating refresh (30d); reuse of used refresh token signals theft and revokes device; 60s idempotent retry window for lost responses.

nodes.label: Author Type
nodes.rationale: Server assigns author by who sent the update, not client claim; guest shareId is hashed so link id (a credential) never leaks.

nodes.label: device_revoked 401 with reason
nodes.rationale: Only this code wipes local data; plain 401 just re-auth

nodes.label: Invitations
nodes.rationale: Identical response and timing whether account exists or not, to prevent enumeration; 30-day lifetime, 50/day limit.

nodes.label: keyRotationPending / pendingSinceVersion
nodes.rationale: Lets any owner device detect where an interrupted key rotation stopped.

nodes.label: Signup Controls (DS_SIGNUP, daily limit, invite code)
nodes.rationale: Uniform 409 on any conflict to avoid account enumeration; daily cap and per-user quota from security review 2026-11-02.

nodes.label: Owner Confirmation for accountCreatedAfterInvite
nodes.rationale: Email is not verified at signup, so owner must confirm before key is given to accounts created after invite.

nodes.label: Refresh Token Rotation & Reuse Detection
nodes.rationale: Reuse after 60s or after new token used => device revoke; idempotent within 60s so network loss does not log users out.
